# NewEdenKit.Sde

> .NET library for EVE Online's Static Data Export (SDE, https://developers.eveonline.com/static-data): downloads
> and caches SDE builds, streams their records as typed models, and loads them into storage you control. Built-in
> SdeFileStore keeps one file per dataset for loading into memory; implement ISdeStore for a database or cache.
> Skips unchanged builds and re-imports only changed datasets. .NET 8/10, no dependencies.

Quick start (`dotnet add package NewEdenKit.Sde`):

<!-- snippet: quickstart -->
```csharp
using var client = new SdeClient(new SdeClientOptions { UserAgent = "MyApp/1.0 (admin@example.com)" });
var loader = new SdeLoader(client);
var store = new SdeFileStore("sde-cache");

// Downloads the SDE only when there is a new build, and caches just these datasets.
await loader.LoadAsync(store, new SdeLoadOptions
{
    Datasets = [SdeDatasets.Types, SdeDatasets.Groups],
});

Dictionary<int, ItemType> types = await store.ReadDictionaryAsync(SdeDatasets.Types);
Console.WriteLine(types[34].Name.En); // Tritanium
```

Key facts:
- Types are in `NewEdenKit.Sde` (SdeClient, SdeLoader, SdeFileStore, SdeReader, SdeDatasets, LocalizedString) and
  `NewEdenKit.Sde.Models` (ItemType, ItemGroup, SolarSystem, Blueprint, ...).
- Pick datasets with `SdeLoadOptions.Datasets`: `SdeDatasets.Types`, `.Groups`, `.SolarSystems`, ... (30 typed),
  presets `SdeDatasets.Items` and `SdeDatasets.All`, `SdeDatasets.Raw("skins")` for untyped ones (JsonElement).
- `Id` is the record key (type ID, system ID, ...), `int`. Text is `LocalizedString` (`Name.En`, `Name.Get("de")`).
  Optional fields are nullable; lists are never null.
- Call `LoadAsync` at startup and on a schedule, not per request; it does nothing when the store is current.
- Custom storage: implement `ISdeStore` (build number + import session). Each `ImportAsync<T>` call carries a complete
  dataset; pattern-match `records is IAsyncEnumerable<ItemType>`; commit in `CommitAsync`.
- The SDE has no live data (market prices, assets): use ESI (NewEdenKit.ESI) for that.

## Docs

- [Usage guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NewEdenKit/NewEdenKit.SDE/main/docs/usage.md): choosing an approach,
  the client and cache, reading builds, the file store, keeping current, custom stores, models, common lookups (dogma,
  blueprints, map), untyped datasets, testing, and common mistakes. Every example in it is compiled by the tests.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NewEdenKit/NewEdenKit.SDE/main/README.md): overview.

## Optional

- [CCP's SDE page](https://developers.eveonline.com/static-data): formats, endpoints and change lists.
- [NewEdenKit.ESI](https://github.com/NewEdenKit/NewEdenKit.ESI/blob/main/llms.txt): the ESI client, for live data.
